facts.text: I need a B2B marketing strategy for a company that supplies the UK’s KBB and furniture industry.
The company is an internationally trusted manufacturer and distributor of furniture fittings, accessories, hardware, and ironmongery.
The company supplies tools, fixings, handles, and innovative storage solutions.
The company supplies sliding door systems.
The company supplies rise and fall desks.
The company has 25,000 globally-sourced products in stock.
The company offers free next day delivery.
Recent research found that one in five people don’t like their current kitchen.
The top three bugbears cited were badly designed storage, limited space, and poor layout.
Among homeowners we spoke to, 86% reported that their kitchen affects their emotional and mental health.
The research findings are valuable insight to customers including furniture manufacturers, kitchen designers, and installers.
I want to plan a content strategy using these research findings to achieve customer engagement and acquisition objectives for furniture manufacturers, kitchen designers, and installers.
I want to coordinate resources to deliver the content strategy.
I want to know what my first 90 days at this company would look like as a creative content manager.
I want to know what I would prioritise in order to deliver the existing content strategy.
I want to understand what developing a reporting framework to measure the effectiveness of the content strategy would entail.
I want to know how to break down developing a reporting framework effectively.
I want to know what metrics could best be used to track customer engagement and acquisition.
